newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hong Kong tourist arrested, 17 kgs of heroin found.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong tourist arrested, 17 kgs of heroin found.

text.p: Police said on Sunday they had arrested a Hong Kong tourist on suspicion of attempting to smuggle about 17 kgs (37.4 lbs) of heroin to the British colony.
Anti-narcotic police said the man in his mid 20s was arrested at the departure lounge of Bangkok's Don Muang airport on Saturday evening while he was waiting to board a flight for Hong Kong.
Police said in a statement that the tourist, who had spent four days in Thailand, was found carrying a large black and brown bag with the drug stashed inside.
Police estimated the domestic Thai price of the heroin at 12 million baht ($480,000) but said it could fetch 10 times more when sold overseas.
It was not immediately known how the man would plea in court. Police said they would charge him with possession of heroin for trafficking and export.
If convicted of the charge, Wong would face a mandatory death sentence although no foreigner has been executed in Thailand in the past several decades.
